title: Email Address Pivoting
summary: Pivot from an email to accounts, avatars, and public mentions.
objective: Build an account/presence map from one email.
steps: Normalize email and capture first-seen context.
Check Gravatar/public profile hashes where applicable.
Search quotes of the full email on the web.
Look for GitHub/GitLab commits and paste mentions.
If using breach datasets, only via lawful/owned-domain services.
ethics: Authorized investigations and public sources only. Do not access systems without permission.
